name: Delivery Exception Resolution
description: Orchestrates instant driver triage, replacement vehicle assignment, manager cost approval, and customer ETA alignment.

nodes.title: Identify On-Route Driver
nodes.description: Locate driver assigned to stalled vehicle and determine breakdown coordinates.

nodes.title: CALL-E Driver Triage
nodes.goal: Verify vehicle condition, physical safety, and recovery ETA.

nodes.title: CALL-E Warehouse Dispatch
nodes.goal: Check spare van availability and emergency departure timing.

nodes.title: CALL-E Ops Approval
nodes.goal: Authorize additional emergency dispatch budget under ₹2,000 threshold.

nodes.title: CALL-E Customer Confirmation
nodes.goal: Confirm revised arrival window (17:00) with recipient.

nodes.title: Task Resolved
nodes.action: Close ticket, send automated tracking link, notify dispatch log.

name: Cold-Chain Temperature Alert
description: Autonomous escalation when refrigerated temperature breaches thresholds during transit.

nodes.title: Identify Reefer Tech
nodes.description: Locate nearest certified cold-chain technician on standby.

nodes.title: CALL-E Triage Unit
nodes.goal: Check compressor status, auxiliary power, and battery health.

nodes.title: CALL-E Quality Assurance
nodes.goal: Obtain product quarantine guidance or diversion authorization.

nodes.title: Temperature Normalized
nodes.action: Produce sensor integrity report for compliance audit.

name: High-Value Order Hold & SLA Escalation
description: Handles enterprise customer critical shipment holds and immediate executive resolution.

nodes.title: Identify Key Account Director
nodes.description: Check SLA terms and strategic account tolerance.

nodes.title: CALL-E Strategic Alignment
nodes.goal: Determine priority flight-freight or same-day courier dispatch.

nodes.title: CALL-E Client Procurement Contact
nodes.goal: Explain proactive mitigation plan and secure delivery acceptance.

nodes.title: VIP Satisfaction Secured
nodes.action: Record executive signoff and auto-issue service guarantee credit.
